name: Belet

wants.text: To know why the name will not leave her

fears: being right about something she cannot prove
contradiction: She trusts her craft and distrusts her own conclusions.

provenance.notes: An invented temple singer. Cult personnel and liturgical performance are attested at Ugarit.

voice.register: Liturgical cadence in ordinary speech; sudden bluntness; grief held under work.
tics: turning a lamp down without putting it out
sampleLines: If you have come to look, look from the doorway.
Names are not only names. If they were, I would be out of work.
It has been a year and the word is still strange.
